verdict.rationale: A built-in AI assistant is a plausible feature for a company-formation and compliance SaaS, so the axis applies. The pack only mentions "AI-powered, human-managed bookkeeping" with live chat to a human bookkeeper, which is an AI-assisted back-office service, not an in-product assistant that takes delegated tasks. That is adjacent support at most, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
